entries.en: The old case notes described an apyous wound but recorded no follow-up examination.
entries.zh: 旧病例笔记描述了一处无脓的伤口，但没有记录后续检查。

entries.en: The report compared apyrase activity in the two samples without identifying the source of the difference.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两份样品中三磷酸腺苷双磷酸酶的活性，但没有确定差异的来源。

entries.en: The microscopist marked the apyrene cells with small arrows in the photograph.
entries.zh: 显微镜观察者在照片中用小箭头标出了无核细胞。

entries.en: The chart showed an apyrexial interval between the two recorded episodes of fever.
entries.zh: 图表显示，两次记录在案的发热之间有一段无热期。

entries.en: The reviewer asked what evidence supported the claim that the preparation was apyrogenetic.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，有什么证据支持该制剂不致热的说法。

entries.en: The study discussed an apyrogenic preparation without claiming that it was safe in every other respect.
entries.zh: 研究讨论了一种不致热的制剂，但没有宣称它在其他各方面也都安全。

entries.en: The historian compared references to apyron in two early pharmaceutical catalogues.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两本早期药品目录中有关乙酰水杨酸锂的记述。

entries.en: The old workshop manual recommended an apyrous lining but gave no test results.
entries.zh: 那本旧工坊手册建议使用耐火衬层，却没有提供测试结果。

entries.meaningZh: 浆液性虹膜炎〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The casebook's account of aquacapsulitis included a drawing of the affected eye.
entries.zh: 病例集对浆液性虹膜炎的记述中，附有患眼绘图。

entries.en: The historical pesticide inventory listed Aquacide separately from the other herbicides.
entries.zh: 历史农药清单将敌草快与其他除草剂分别列出。

entries.en: The engineer checked the continuity of the Aquadag coating before examining the remaining connections.
entries.zh: 工程师先检查了胶体石墨涂层的连续性，再检查其余连接。

entries.en: The pharmacist discussed the aquae separately from the alcoholic preparations in the old formulary.
entries.zh: 药剂师将旧处方集中的水剂与含酒精制剂分开讨论。

entries.en: The anatomist traced the aquaeductus through the enlarged drawing rather than cutting the specimen.
entries.zh: 解剖学家沿着放大的图追看导管，而没有切开标本。

entries.en: The pharmacy archive retained an Aquakay package with its original printed leaflet.
entries.zh: 药房档案保存着一个甲萘醌包装，内有原来的印刷说明单。

entries.en: The researcher compared the aquayamycin spectrum with the reference spectrum supplied by another laboratory.
entries.zh: 研究者将水绫霉素的光谱与另一实验室提供的参照光谱作了比较。

entries.en: The botanist grouped the Aquifoliaceae specimens by collection site before comparing their leaves.
entries.zh: 植物学家先按采集地点将冬青科标本分组，再比较它们的叶片。

entries.en: The old physiology text described an aquiparous tissue without explaining its proposed mechanism.
entries.zh: 那本旧生理学书描述了一种生水组织，却没有解释所提出的机制。

entries.en: The diagram distinguished an aquo-complex from the compound drawn on the next page.
entries.zh: 示意图区分了水络合物与下一页所画的化合物。

entries.en: The chemist compared the aquo-compound with the corresponding material after water had been removed.
entries.zh: 化学家将含水化合物与除水后的相应材料作了比较。

entries.en: The analyst kept the aquocobalamin results separate from the results for other cobalamin derivatives.
entries.zh: 分析人员将水钴胺素的结果与其他钴胺素衍生物的结果分开记录。

entries.en: The old account emphasized the aquosity of the fluid rather than its colour.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述着重描述液体的水样性质，而不是其颜色。

entries.en: The chemist highlighted the ar-methoxy-benzylidene group before explaining the rest of the structural drawing.
entries.zh: 化学家先标出甲氧苯亚甲基，再解释结构图的其余部分。

entries.en: The graph compared the breakdown of araban in the treated and untreated samples.
entries.zh: 图表比较了处理样品与未经处理样品中阿拉伯聚糖的分解情况。

entries.en: The researchers measured arabanase activity rather than assuming that all enzymes in the mixture behaved alike.
entries.zh: 研究人员测量了阿拉伯聚糖酶活性，而没有假定混合物中所有酶的表现都相同。

entries.en: The old chemistry text distinguished an arabate from the acid used to form it.
entries.zh: 那本旧化学书区分了阿拉伯酸盐与生成这种盐所用的酸。

entries.en: The essay examined debates within Arabdom rather than presenting the region as politically uniform.
entries.zh: 那篇文章考察了阿拉伯世界内部的争论，而没有把该地区说成政治立场一致。

entries.en: Arabel left her notebook on the train and returned to the station to ask about it.
entries.zh: 阿拉贝尔把笔记本落在火车上，便返回车站询问。

entries.en: The collection contained several Arabellidae specimens that had been identified by different specialists.
entries.zh: 收藏中有几件花索沙蚕科标本，分别由不同专家鉴定。

entries.en: The historian compared the descriptions of arabin in two early studies of plant gums.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两项早期植物树胶研究对阿拉伯树胶酸的描述。

entries.en: The laboratory report discussed arabinogalactan without treating it as interchangeable with every other plant polysaccharide.
entries.zh: 实验室报告讨论了阿拉伯半乳聚糖，但没有把它与所有其他植物多糖混为一谈。

entries.meaningZh: 阿糖基葡萄糖醛酸基木聚糖
entries.en: The seminar compared arabinoglucuronoxylan from the two archived plant samples.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了两份存档植物样品中的阿糖基葡萄糖醛酸基木聚糖。

entries.en: The analyst distinguished arabinose from the other sugars shown on the chromatogram.
entries.zh: 分析人员区分了阿拉伯糖与色谱图上显示的其他糖。

entries.en: The gardener moved the arabis away from the path before repairing the stone edging.
entries.zh: 园丁修理石质边缘前，把筷子芥从小径旁移开了。

entries.en: The chart placed arabitol beside the other sugar alcohols being compared.
entries.zh: 图表将阿拉伯糖醇与正在比较的其他糖醇并列。

entries.en: The historian studied the Arabization of public administration through surviving official correspondence.
entries.zh: 史学研究者通过留存的官方通信，研究公共行政的阿拉伯化。

entries.en: The committee proposed to Arabize the course materials while retaining the original texts for comparison.
entries.zh: 委员会提议将课程材料阿拉伯化，同时保留原文以供对照。

entries.en: We reached our hotel in Aracaju after dark and collected our keys from the receptionist.
entries.zh: 天黑后，我们到达阿拉卡茹的酒店，从接待员那里取了钥匙。

entries.en: The herbarium kept its Araceae specimens together while the catalogue was being revised.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆修订目录期间，将天南星科标本集中存放。

entries.en: The reviewer asked how arachain had been distinguished from the other enzymes in the extract.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，如何将花生仁蛋白酶与提取物中的其他酶区分开来。

entries.en: The old report compared arachidic oil with several other oils in the collection.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告将花生油与收藏中的其他几种油作了比较。

entries.en: The study examined arachin separately from the other proteins found in the peanut samples.
entries.zh: 研究将花生球蛋白与花生样品中发现的其他蛋白质分开考察。

entries.en: The agricultural collection included arachis grown from seeds supplied by another institute.
entries.zh: 农业收藏中有用另一研究机构提供的种子培育的落花生。

entries.meaningZh: 阿拉克尼〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The tapestry showed Arachne at her loom while spectators gathered around her.
entries.zh: 挂毯画着阿拉克尼在织机旁，周围聚集着观众。

entries.en: The interview discussed her arachnephobia without assuming that every dislike of spiders was a disorder.
entries.zh: 访谈讨论了她对蜘蛛的恐惧，但没有认定所有不喜欢蜘蛛的情况都是疾病。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished Arachnida from insects before introducing the specimens on the table.
entries.zh: 讲者先区分蛛形纲与昆虫，再介绍桌上的标本。

entries.meaningZh: 细长指趾；蜘蛛脚样指趾
entries.en: The drawing illustrated arachnodactyly without identifying the condition responsible for the unusual finger shape.
entries.zh: 绘图展示了细长指趾，但没有确定造成异常手指形态的疾病。

entries.en: The anatomist marked the arachnoidal layer in a different colour from the neighbouring membranes.
entries.zh: 解剖学家用不同于邻近膜层的颜色标出了蛛网膜层。

entries.meaningZh: 蛛形类〔旧动物分类名称〕
entries.en: The old zoological catalogue grouped Arachnoidea separately from insects and crustaceans.
entries.zh: 那本旧动物学目录将蛛形类与昆虫、甲壳动物分开归类。

entries.meaningZh: 蛛网膜内皮瘤〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared the descriptions of arachnoidendothelioma in the hospital's surviving pathology records.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了医院留存的病理记录对蛛网膜内皮瘤的描述。

entries.en: The case review discussed arachnoidism but did not identify the species involved.
entries.zh: 病例回顾讨论了蛛毒中毒，但没有确定涉及的物种。

entries.en: The historical diagram represented the arachnopia as a single covering rather than two separate membranes.
entries.zh: 那张历史示意图将蛛软膜画成一层覆盖结构，而不是两层分开的膜。

entries.en: We stopped in Arad in Romania to collect the documents before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在罗马尼亚的阿拉德停留取文件，然后继续旅行。

entries.en: The entomologist examined the Aradidae specimens under a magnifier before checking the identification key.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家先用放大镜观察扁蝽科标本，再查阅检索表。

entries.en: The historian compared maps of Arakan drawn by travellers working in different decades.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了不同时期的旅行者绘制的若开地图。

entries.en: The bridge over the Araks was visible from the path where we stopped for lunch.
entries.zh: 我们停下吃午饭的小路上，可以看到阿拉斯河上的桥。

entries.en: The map of the Aral Sea carried a date beside each recorded shoreline.
entries.zh: 咸海地图在每一条有记录的岸线旁都标注了日期。

entries.en: The textile exhibition compared aralac with other fibres developed during the same period.
entries.zh: 纺织展将酪蛋白纤维与同一时期研制的其他纤维作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 天南星目〔旧植物分类名称〕
entries.en: The historical classification placed Arales on a separate branch of the botanical chart.
entries.zh: 那套历史分类把天南星目列在植物分类图的一条独立分支上。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Araliaceae specimens using photographs taken from the same angle.
entries.zh: 植物学家利用从相同角度拍摄的照片，比较五加科标本。

entries.en: The gardener kept the araliaceous plants together while the glasshouse benches were repaired.
entries.zh: 温室工作台维修期间，园丁把五加科植物集中摆放。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the Aramine entry against the original hospital inventory.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照医院原始清单核查了阿拉明这一项。

entries.en: The survey recorded Araneae separately from the other groups of small animals collected.
entries.zh: 调查将蜘蛛类与采集到的其他小型动物类群分开记录。

entries.en: Her interest in araneology began when she photographed webs in the abandoned greenhouse.
entries.zh: 她在废弃温室里拍摄蛛网时，开始对蜘蛛学产生兴趣。

entries.en: The specialist compared the Araneus specimens before assigning them to separate species.
entries.zh: 专家先比较园蛛属标本，再将它们分归不同物种。

entries.en: The linguist compared a passage in Araucan with a translation prepared by another researcher.
entries.zh: 语言学家将一段阿劳干语组语言的文字与另一研究者所作的译文作了比较。

entries.en: The linguist checked the Araucanian transcription against the recording before publishing the interview.
entries.zh: 语言学家发表访谈前，先对照录音核查了阿洛柯语转写文本。

entries.en: The botanical collection displayed Araucariaceae in a section devoted to conifers.
entries.zh: 植物收藏将南洋杉科陈列在专门介绍针叶树的区域。

entries.meaningZh: Arava〔含来氟米特的药物商品名〕
entries.en: The pharmacist found Arava on the medication list and checked the name against the package.
entries.zh: 药剂师在用药清单上看到了 Arava，并对照包装核查了名称。

entries.en: Arber returned the borrowed map with a note explaining the pencilled markings.
entries.zh: 阿尔伯归还了借来的地图，并附上解释铅笔标记的字条。

entries.meaningZh: 虫媒的；由节肢动物传播的
entries.en: The review grouped the arbo infections separately from infections spread by direct contact.
entries.zh: 综述将虫媒感染与通过直接接触传播的感染分开归类。

entries.en: Arbon offered to carry the folded chairs while I looked for the hall key.
entries.zh: 我寻找礼堂钥匙时，阿尔邦提出帮忙搬折叠椅。

entries.meaningZh: 树状结构〔旧解剖学复数名称〕
entries.en: The illustrator outlined the arbores in the two anatomical drawings using different colours.
entries.zh: 插画师用不同颜色勾出了两幅解剖图中的树状结构。

entries.en: Arborio signed the delivery note after counting the boxes stacked beside the door.
entries.zh: 阿尔博里奥数过门旁堆放的箱子后，在送货单上签了字。

entries.en: The enlarged image showed the arborization of the nerve fibres more clearly than the original photograph.
entries.zh: 放大的图像比原始照片更清楚地显示了神经纤维的树枝状分枝。

entries.en: The zoologist drew the arboroid colony before describing the arrangement of its branches.
entries.zh: 动物学家先画出树样分枝的群体，再描述其分枝排列。

entries.meaningZh: 虫媒病毒的；由虫媒病毒引起的
entries.en: The review discussed arboviral infections without assuming that all were transmitted by the same vector.
entries.zh: 综述讨论了虫媒病毒感染，但没有假定它们都由同一种媒介传播。

entries.en: The institute's course in arbovirology included a session on interpreting historical outbreak reports.
entries.zh: 研究机构的虫媒病毒学课程包括一节解读历史疫情报告的课。

entries.en: Arbus waited outside the lecture room while the technician repaired the projector.
entries.zh: 技术人员修理投影仪时，阿尔比斯在讲堂外等候。

entries.en: The chromatogram showed arbutin separately from the other compounds discussed in the report.
entries.zh: 色谱图将熊果苷与报告中讨论的其他化合物分别显示。

entries.meaningZh: 阿卡狄亚；田园乐土〔诗歌用语〕
entries.en: In the poem, Arcady offered the weary traveller a refuge from the noise of the city.
entries.zh: 诗中，田园乐土为疲惫的旅人提供了远离城市喧嚣的栖身之所。

entries.en: The chemist compared the arcaine measurements with the values recorded in the earlier notebook.
entries.zh: 化学家将蚶碱的测量结果与较早笔记本中记录的数值作了比较。

entries.en: The microscopist photographed Arcella before changing the slide to examine another sample.
entries.zh: 显微镜观察者先拍摄了蕈状变形虫属生物，再更换载玻片观察另一份样品。

entries.en: The specialist checked the Arcellidae specimens against the illustrations in the identification guide.
entries.zh: 专家对照鉴定指南中的插图，核查表壳科标本。

entries.en: The botanist compared Arceuthobium specimens collected from different trees without assuming they belonged to one species.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了从不同树木上采集的油杉寄生属标本，但没有假定它们属于同一物种。

entries.en: The geologist compared the Archaean rocks with younger material from the neighbouring site.
entries.zh: 地质学家将太古代岩石与邻近地点年代较晚的材料作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 古鲸亚目〔古动物分类名称〕
entries.en: The curator compared the Archaeoceti fossils before arranging the whale-evolution display.
entries.zh: 馆员布置鲸类演化展览前，先比较了古鲸亚目的化石。

entries.en: The catalogue placed Archaeocidaridae in a section devoted to fossil sea urchins.
entries.zh: 目录将古头帕海胆科列在专门介绍海胆化石的部分。

entries.en: The biologist followed an archaeocyte across successive images without assuming that its shape remained constant.
entries.zh: 生物学家通过连续图像追踪一个游走变形细胞，而没有假定其形状始终不变。

entries.en: The specialist examined the Archaeopsylla specimens before updating the flea catalogue.
entries.zh: 专家先检查昔蚤属标本，再更新跳蚤目录。

entries.en: The historical chart grouped Archaeornithes separately from the birds represented on the next panel.
entries.zh: 那张历史分类图将古鸟亚纲与下一块展板上的鸟类分开归类。

entries.en: The microbiologist compared the Archangium records from two independently labelled collections.
entries.zh: 微生物学家比较了两套独立标记的收藏中关于原囊黏菌属的记录。

entries.meaningZh: 太古人亚科〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The lecturer explained where Archanthropinae appeared in the historical classification rather than presenting it as current terminology.
entries.zh: 讲者解释了太古人亚科在历史分类中的位置，而没有把它说成现行术语。

entries.meaningZh: 自然发生；生物自生〔旧学说用语〕
entries.en: The historian discussed archebiosis as a proposed explanation, not as an established account of living organisms.
entries.zh: 史学研究者把生物自生当作一种曾被提出的解释来讨论，而没有将其视为关于生物的定论。

entries.en: The botanist marked the archegone in the enlarged drawing of the reproductive structure.
entries.zh: 植物学家在生殖结构的放大图中标出了藏卵器。

entries.meaningZh: 自然发生；无生源说〔旧用语〕
entries.en: The seminar compared arguments about archegony in two nineteenth-century accounts of the origin of life.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了两份十九世纪生命起源论述中有关无生源说的论点。

entries.en: The lecturer compared two drawings of the archencephalon before discussing differences in the authors' terminology.
entries.zh: 讲者先比较了两幅原脑绘图，再讨论两位作者的术语差异。

entries.meaningZh: 原始运动的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The author discussed archeocinetic responses separately from movements acquired through later practice.
entries.zh: 作者将原始运动反应与后来通过练习习得的动作分开讨论。

entries.en: The botanist drew the archicarp in outline before adding the surrounding fungal structures.
entries.zh: 植物学家先勾画出产囊体的轮廓，再补画周围的真菌结构。

entries.en: The comparative-anatomy lecture placed the archicerebrum drawings beside the other diagrams under discussion.
entries.zh: 比较解剖学讲座将原脑绘图与正在讨论的其他示意图并列展示。

entries.meaningZh: 离瓣花亚纲〔旧植物分类名称〕
entries.en: The historical flora arranged Archichlamydeae in a section separate from the groups that followed.
entries.zh: 那部历史植物志将离瓣花亚纲列为独立部分，与后面的类群分开编排。

entries.en: The museum displayed an archometrum beside the surgeon's surviving measurement notes.
entries.zh: 博物馆将测肛器与那位外科医生留存的测量笔记并列展出。

entries.en: The inscription named an archon but did not record how long he held office.
entries.zh: 铭文提到了一名执政官，却没有记载他的任期有多长。

entries.meaningZh: 初原生质；初浆〔旧细胞学名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared descriptions of archoplasm in early accounts of cellular movement.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了早期细胞运动论述对初浆的描述。

entries.en: The case notes mentioned archorrhagia without identifying the cause of the bleeding.
entries.zh: 病例笔记提到了肛门出血，但没有确定出血的原因。

entries.en: The curator compared the Archosargus specimens with the drawings in the older fish catalogue.
entries.zh: 馆员将羊鲷属标本与旧鱼类目录中的绘图作了比较。

entries.en: The lecturer introduced Archosauria before discussing the relationships shown on the evolutionary tree.
entries.zh: 讲者先介绍了主龙类，再讨论演化树上显示的亲缘关系。

entries.en: The casebook's discussion of archostenosis referred to a drawing that had not survived.
entries.zh: 病例集对肛门狭窄的讨论提到了一幅未能保存下来的绘图。

entries.en: The old surgical notes described an archosyrinx without proposing a particular cause.
entries.zh: 那份旧外科笔记描述了一处肛瘘，但没有提出特定病因。

entries.en: The collection's Arcidae specimens were photographed before their damaged storage boxes were replaced.
entries.zh: 收藏中的蚶科标本在破损存放盒被更换前接受了拍摄。

entries.en: The technician documented the ARCnet connections before disconnecting the old equipment.
entries.zh: 技术人员先记录了 ARCnet 网络连接，再断开旧设备。

entries.en: We reached Arcot after dark and postponed the archive visit until the following morning.
entries.zh: 我们天黑后才抵达阿尔乔特，把档案馆之行推迟到了第二天上午。

entries.en: The physician's drawing showed arctation but did not explain when the narrowing had developed.
entries.zh: 医生的绘图显示了孔道狭窄，却没有解释狭窄何时形成。

entries.en: The zoologist compared Arctictis specimens from two collections before revising the catalogue.
entries.zh: 动物学家先比较了两套收藏中的熊狸属标本，再修订目录。

entries.en: The old insect collection kept Arctiidae together in a drawer lined with faded paper.
entries.zh: 那套旧昆虫收藏将灯蛾科集中存放在一个衬有褪色纸张的抽屉中。

entries.en: The botanist sketched Arctium beside the path before collecting a specimen.
entries.zh: 植物学家先在小径旁画下牛蒡属植物，再采集标本。

entries.en: The zoological catalogue included Arctocebus in its section on primates.
entries.zh: 那本动物学目录将金熊猴属列在灵长类部分。

entries.en: The curator compared the Arctocephalus skulls before arranging the marine-mammal display.
entries.zh: 馆员布置海洋哺乳动物展览前，先比较了南海狗属的头骨。

entries.meaningZh: 熊犬科〔古哺乳动物分类名称〕
entries.en: The palaeontologist compared the Arctocyonidae fossils with specimens from another extinct mammal group.
entries.zh: 古生物学家将熊犬科化石与另一灭绝哺乳动物类群的标本作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 窄鳞鱼目〔古鱼类分类名称〕
entries.en: The historical catalogue placed Arctolepiformes in a section devoted to extinct fishes.
entries.zh: 那本历史目录将窄鳞鱼目列在专门介绍灭绝鱼类的部分。

entries.en: The mammal collection contained several Arctonyx specimens awaiting a specialist's examination.
entries.zh: 哺乳动物收藏中有几件猪獾属标本，正在等待专家检查。

entries.en: The gardener moved the Arctotis plants before replacing the cracked pots.
entries.zh: 园丁更换裂开的花盆前，先移走了羽毛菊属植物。

entries.en: The specialist compared the Arcturidae specimens in the museum's crustacean collection.
entries.zh: 专家比较了博物馆甲壳动物收藏中的熊虾科标本。

entries.en: The lecturer used an enlarged drawing to explain the arcual arrangement of the structures.
entries.zh: 讲者用一幅放大的绘图解释了这些结构的弓形排列。

entries.en: We returned to Arcueil to collect the papers that had been left at the office.
entries.zh: 我们返回阿尔克伊，取留在办公室的文件。

entries.en: The nurse adjusted the arculus so that the bedclothes rested above the patient's injured leg.
entries.zh: 护士调整了被褥支架，使被褥架在患者受伤的腿上方。

entries.en: The palaeontologist checked the Arcyzonidae specimens against the illustrations in the older catalogue.
entries.zh: 古生物学家对照旧目录中的插图，核查网带介科标本。

entries.en: The report compared records from Ardabil Province with records supplied by neighbouring provinces.
entries.zh: 报告将阿尔达比勒省的记录与邻省提供的记录作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 温度觉缺失〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The case description of ardanesthesia reported that the patient could not distinguish warmth from cold.
entries.zh: 那份关于温度觉缺失的病例说明称，患者无法分辨温暖与寒冷。

entries.en: We stayed in Ardea until the borrowed equipment could be returned to its owner.
entries.zh: 我们留在阿尔代亚，直到能把借来的设备归还给物主。

entries.en: The bird survey recorded Ardeidae separately from the other families observed along the river.
entries.zh: 鸟类调查将鹭科与沿河观察到的其他科分开记录。

entries.en: The collector photographed the ardennite specimen before repairing its damaged display label.
entries.zh: 收藏者先拍摄了硅铝锰矿标本，再修复受损的展示标签。

entries.en: Ardis lent me a spare notebook when mine was soaked by the rain.
entries.zh: 我的笔记本被雨淋湿后，阿迪丝借给我一本备用笔记本。

entries.en: The botanist compared Ardisia specimens collected at different stages of growth.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了在不同生长阶段采集的紫金牛属标本。

entries.en: The train to Ardmore was delayed, so we waited inside the station cafe.
entries.zh: 开往阿德莫尔的火车晚点了，于是我们在车站咖啡馆里等候。

entries.en: The botanical garden displayed Arecaceae in a section devoted to palms.
entries.zh: 植物园将槟榔科植物陈列在专门介绍棕榈类的区域。

entries.en: The historian distinguished arecaine from arecoline in the early account of betel-nut alkaloids.
entries.zh: 史学研究者在那份早期槟榔生物碱论述中，区分了槟榔次碱与槟榔碱。

entries.en: The old report discussed arecaline separately from the other compounds obtained from the plant sample.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告将槟榔碱与从植物样品中取得的其他化合物分开讨论。

entries.en: The analyst compared the arecoline spectrum with the reference spectrum before completing the report.
entries.zh: 分析人员完成报告前，将槟榔碱的光谱与参照光谱作了比较。

entries.en: The paper described an aregenerative response without claiming that the observation established its cause.
entries.zh: 论文描述了一种再生障碍性反应，但没有宣称该观察确定了其成因。

entries.en: The researcher compared the arenaemycin results with the observations recorded in an earlier study.
entries.zh: 研究者将阿雷纳霉素的结果与较早研究中记录的观察作了比较。

entries.en: The botanist compared Arenaria specimens before revising the labels in the plant collection.
entries.zh: 植物学家修订植物收藏的标签前，先比较了蚤缀属标本。

entries.en: The historian compared the early arenarin reports without accepting every antibacterial claim as established.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了早期沙质菌素报告，但没有将每一项抗菌宣称都视为定论。

entries.en: The historical pamphlet advertised arenation without providing evidence for the benefits it promised.
entries.zh: 那本历史小册子宣传热砂浴，却没有提供所承诺益处的证据。

entries.en: The review discussed Arenaviridae separately from the other virus families in the survey.
entries.zh: 综述将沙粒病毒科与调查中的其他病毒科分开讨论。

entries.en: The geologist compared fossils assigned to the Arenigian with specimens from the overlying beds.
entries.zh: 地质学家将归入阿仑尼克阶的化石与上覆岩层的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The analyst checked the arenobufagin results against the instrument record rather than relying on a copied table.
entries.zh: 分析人员对照仪器记录核查了沙地蟾蜍素的结果，而没有依赖抄录的表格。

entries.en: The magnified image showed an arenoid texture rather than a smooth, continuous surface.
entries.zh: 放大图像显示的是沙状质地，而不是平滑连续的表面。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing marked both areolae with small arrows rather than colouring the entire chest.
entries.zh: 解剖图用小箭头标出两处乳晕，而没有为整个胸部着色。

entries.en: The botanist compared the areolation of the two leaves using enlarged photographs.
entries.zh: 植物学家利用放大的照片，比较了两片叶子的网眼状结构。

entries.en: The case notes mentioned areolitis but did not identify the cause of the inflammation.
entries.zh: 病例笔记提到了乳晕炎，但没有确定炎症的原因。

entries.en: The technician checked the areometer reading before entering the liquid's specific gravity in the notebook.
entries.zh: 技术人员先核查了液体比重计的读数，再将液体比重记入笔记本。

entries.en: The report compared the areometric measurements with values obtained by a different method.
entries.zh: 报告将液体比重测量结果与另一种方法取得的数值作了比较。
